mapper.select:
select DISTINCT plp.Prod_Style id, plp.Prod_Style text, FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID object from FIN_PRODUCT inner join prd_layer_param plp on FIN_PRODUCT.Finprod_Id=plp.finprod_id INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID OR PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = plp.p_finprod_id INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID
where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16','F24') AND FIN_PRODUCT.Profit_Type='02'
AND plp.Prod_Style like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%'))
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue}

SELECT FINPROD_ID id, FINPROD_ABBR text FROM FIN_PRODUCT
P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}
AND (FINPROD_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))

SELECT SUM(count) FROM ( SELECT count(*) count FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_PRODUCT, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD WHERE FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.IS_LAY = #{YESORNON} and FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') UNION ALL
SELECT count(*) count FROM FIN_PRODUCT A,FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD WHERE A.Finprod_Id = R.FINPROD_ID and A.P_FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID and AD.IS_LAY = #{YESORNOY} and A.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and R.Eff_Date = to_date(#{effDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') )

SELECT VDATE vdate, MDATE mdate FROM FIN_PRODUCT
FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, B.VAL_DATE effDate, B.PUBLISH_DATE releaseDate, B.VALUATION valuation, B.DAY7_YEAR_YIELD day7YearYield, B.YEAR_YIELD yearYield, B.TOTAL_VALUE totalValue, B.REMARK remark FROM FIN_PRODUCT A, FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION B WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND B.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND to_char(B.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{effDate}

select from PRD_LAYER_PARAM where P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and VDATE = to_date(#{effDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT P.Prod_Style prodStyle, p.term_min termMin, p.term_max termMax, p.amt_min amtMin, p.amt_max amtMax, NVL2(C.YIELD, C.YIELD * 100, C.YIELD) yield, A.Finprod_Id finprodId, CA.CASH_ID cashId FROM FIN_PRODUCT A, Prd_Layer_Param P, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE C, FIN_CASH_INFO CA WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = P.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = CA.FINPROD_ID and a.p_finprod_id= #{finprodId} AND to_char(C.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{effDate} AND CA.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{interest1} AND CA.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{interest2} AND CA.BRANCH = #{branch}
